plot: A woman finds her peaceful home invaded when hitmen pursue a mysterious visitor and missing diamonds.

As Brent’s journey to his final resting place unfolds, the film chronicles the years he and his brother spent covering some of the world’s most dangerous conflicts.

plot: A revealing, edgy, and disarmingly personal journey into the world of superfandom, told through the lens of one of the world's most iconic and enduring artists, Eminem, and the fans that worship him.

plot: An investigation into the downfall of the Montreal Expos, Canada's first Major League Baseball team — and who was ultimately responsible.

As the city loses power and chaos spreads, nature turns feral - and what starts as isolated attacks escalates into a terrifying siege they may not all survive.

It seems tonight may be the night for Jane when she and her friends are hunted by a strange, massive,  force known only as The Dux.

plot: In a dystopian, alternate-America ruled by a totalitarian regime, 50 teenage boys take part in a deadly annual walking contest, forced to maintain a minimum pace or be executed, until only one survivor remains.

plot: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Ivy and Theo: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. plot: When a young boy discovers a Bigfoot monster may be lurking in the woods behind his house, he must face his fear to uncover the truth.

plot: In June 2001, hundreds of kilos of cocaine washed up in a Portuguese village. This gripping documentary reveals the long-lasting impact on the community.

But now that their paths have crossed again, will love be stronger than resentment?

But when they discover the bunker is infested with rabid, zombie, super-humans in a nuclear testing operation gone wrong, they must destroy every last one in hopes of survival.

name: Wind And Bone 2025
plot: a woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural WV, where they come face to face with the Wendigo.

As a result, she frees herself from all filters and begins to practice zero tolerance for all the absurdities that affect her daily life.

Murnau, Giorgione, Andrea del Castagno, Paolo Uccello, Piero della Francesca, Pisanello, Aby Warburg, Edward S. Curtis and Jean Cocteau.

Despite Park Tae-joo facing a predetermined sentence due to his military status, Jung In-hoo fights tirelessly to ensure a fair trial, enraged by the trial's unfair proceedings.

plot: Raised by a man leading a monstrous double life, the daughter of the BTK serial killer shares her chilling story.

The decision is made for him when his old partner’s niece Jamie calls him for help, launching Cash right back into a world of danger, corruption and intrigue.

name: Sheriff Narko Integriti 2024
plot: شريف، ضابط شرطة من إدارة النزاهة، مُخلص وثاقب البصيرة. يتعاون مع نازري، ضابط شرطة شاب ومثالي من إدارة مكافحة المخدرات. مهمتهما هي القبض على عصابة مخدرات يتزعمها زعيم العصابات الوحشي توني. هذا الزعيم متورط في توزيع الميثامفيتامين، وقد مات الكثيرون على يد هذا القاتل.

name: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish 2025
plot: Vulgar, taunting texts blow up the phones of a teen and her boyfriend. Who's sending them — and why? This twisty documentary reveals the shocking answer.

name: Enemigos 2025
plot: Chimo turns 18 years and comes from a humble and supportive family. Since childhood he was bullied and even today, while working multiple jobs and dreaming of starting his own business, he continues to face his bully: El Rubio. When Chimo has the opportunity for revenge, he never imagines what begins as an act of retaliation could turn into an unexpected friendship that'll change both their lives.

name: The Home 2025
plot: يبدأ رجل مضطرب العمل في دار رعاية مسنين، ويدرك أن نزلاءها والقائمين على رعايتها يُخفون أسرارًا شريرة. وبينما يُحقق في المبنى وطابقه الرابع المحظور، يبدأ في كشف صلات تربطه بماضيه ونشأته كطفلٍ مُحتضن.

name: Night Shift 2024
plot: A young nurse with a domestic abuse past starts working the night shift at a small hospital, where, during the night, the ghost of a nurse materializes.

name: Sketch 2024
plot: When a young girl’s sketchbook falls into a strange pond, her drawings come to life—chaotic, real, and on the loose. As the town descends into chaos, her family must reunite and stop the monsters they never meant to unleash.

name: She Rides Shotgun 2025
plot: Newly released from prison and marked for death by unrelenting enemies, Nate must now protect his estranged 11-year-old daughter, Polly, at all costs. With scant resources and no one to trust, Nate and Polly forge a bond under fire as he shows her how to fight and survive—and she teaches him the true meaning of unconditional love.

name: Weapons 2025
plot: عندما يختفي جميع الأطفال من نفس الفصل بشكل غامض في نفس الليلة وفي نفس الوقت تمامًا، يتساءل المجتمع عن من أو ما الذي يقف وراء اختفائهم.

name: The Salt Path 2024
plot: A couple lose their home and later discover the husband has been diagnosed with a terminal illness as they embark on a year long coastal trek.

name: Reading Lolita in Tehran 2024
plot: As Islamic morality squads stage arbitrary raids in Tehran and as fundamentalists seize hold of the universities, Azar Nafisi, an inspired teacher, secretly gathers six of her most committed female students to read forbidden western classics. Unaccustomed to being asked to speak their minds, they soon removed their veils, their stories intertwining with the novels they read: just like the heroines of Nabokov, F. Scott Fitzgerald, Henry James or Jane Austen, the women in Nafisi’s living room dare to dream, hope and love as we experience the complexity of the lives of individuals facing political, moral and personal siege.

name: I Know What You Did Last Summer 2025
plot: When five friends inadvertently cause a deadly car accident, they cover up their involvement and make a pact to keep it a secret rather than face the consequences. A year later, their past comes back to haunt them and they're forced to confront a horrifying truth: someone knows what they did last summer…and is hell-bent on revenge.

name: Night Of Wrath 2025
plot: A group of seemingly virtuous leaders are trapped in a haunted house by a madmen threatening to ruin their lives by revealing their darkest secrets.

name: A Deadly Ride 2025
plot: A young woman finds herself in a fight for survival after her ride share driver accidentally hits a cyclist.

name: Isolated 2025
plot: A nurse and her patient are trying to escape when a violent intruder starts hunting them.

name: Kabir Azabı: İnsi ve Cinni 2024
plot: Nejla and Muhsin's happy life in the first months of their marriage is plunged into darkness when Muhsin dies in an accident. Nejla, who cannot give up on Muhsin, believes that he will return, and every step she takes in this direction will cause her great trouble.

name: Red Sonja 2025
plot: A young girl rises from the ashes of tragedy to become the most feared warrior woman of all time: the She-Devil with a Sword.

name: The Land That Time Forgot 2025
plot: Present-day survivors of a sunken naval vessel capture a Russian sub, only to find themselves stranded on an island filled with deadly, prehistoric creatures

name: Cop and a Half 2025
plot: في قلب جوهانسبرغ الصاخبة، يقتحم ثنائي غير متكافئ ساحة مكافحة الجريمة في فيلم أكشن كوميدي جنوب أفريقي. عندما يُقرن شرطي ملتزم بالقواعد، على مضض، بمخبر لبق، تتطاير شرارات الحب وهما يخوضان غمار عالم تجارة المخدرات الغادر. بروح رفاقية غير متوقعة، يطاردان عصابة تجار مخدرات قاسية، تاركين وراءهما الفوضى والضحك.

name: House on Eden 2025
plot: Paranormal investigators Kris, Celina and their videographer Jay are rerouted to an abandoned house deep in the woods, where they find themselves facing a force unlike anything they've encountered before. As the night spirals into chaos, missing crew members and eerie phenomena hint at an ancient, malevolent presence watching their every move.

name: Bang 2025
plot: A middle aged couple in an open relationship fight over their relationship issues, as their children struggle to tell their parents about their own problems.

name: The Deceased 2025
plot: When their father dies on a cursed day, terror follows siblings Nuri and Yanda as they navigate myths, rituals and their older brother's protests.

name: Fall for Me 2025
plot: Lilli is suspicious of her sister's new fiance, but when an attractive stranger enters her life, she's suddenly distracted by the thralls of desire.

name: Dark Cuts A Thriller Anthology 2025
plot: A pulse-pounding collection of five short films, each delivering a unique slice of suspense, obsession, and psychological terror-where every decision could be your last.

name: Eenie Meanie 2025
plot: A former teenage getaway driver gets dragged back into her unsavory past when a former employer offers her a chance to save the life of her chronically unreliable ex-boyfriend.

name: On the Run 2025
plot: تكتشف شقيقتان مراهقتان تورط عائلتهما في برنامج سري وتقرران الهروب من المجرمين القاتلين الذين يستهدفون عائلتهما.

name: TKO 2025
plot: After reuniting with his estranged sons, a former boxer must step up as a father and a coach when his oldest begins competing in professional boxing.

name: Singsot: Siulan Kematian 2025
plot: A kid defies the ancient taboo of whistling at dusk, unleashing a sinister terror tied to a cursed figure who made the same mistake. Bound by an inescapable curse, he’s thrust into a deadly race against time—because if he fails, the nightmare will become his new reality.

name: Pabrik Gula 2025
plot: مجموعة من الشباب والشابات، يعملون كعمال موسميين في مصنع سكر، يواجهون رعبًا من مملكة الشياطين التي يقع فيها المصنع. عليهم اكتشاف سبب غضب الشياطين قبل أن يُنهي هذا الرعب حياتهم.

name: Jabang Mayit 2025
plot: Hujan mysteriously loses her baby. In desperation, she meets Bayu, who offers help. Bayu took her to a shaman. The shaman reveals that Hujan's baby has been taken by a creature from another world, "Hantu Jabang Mayit", a ghost summoned through dark rituals to target babies of mothers who are not ready to give birth.

name: Gold Rush Gang 2025
plot: At the tail end of World War II, a bandit leader and his crew go up against his sworn enemy and the Japanese army to rob a train full of gold.

name: Hallow Road 2025
plot: Two parents enter a race against time when they receive a distressing late-night phone call from their daughter after she caused a tragic car accident.

name: F1 2025
plot: يتم إقناع أسطورة السباقات سوني هايز بالعودة من التقاعد لقيادة فريق فورمولا 1 المتعثر - وتوجيه سائق شاب موهوب - بينما يطارد فرصة أخرى للمجد.

name: Souls of the Damned 2024
plot: A group of witches gain power of one man's suffering through horrific nightmares.

name: American Psychopath 2025
plot: In the shadows of suburban of America, a mysterious tale unfolds as a girl from out of town becomes the prey of an unidentified serial killer. Making headline news, she must unravel the truth to regain her memory before he kills again.

name: The Map That Leads to You 2025
plot: هيذر شابة تسافر إلى أوروبا مع أصدقائها قبل أن تبدأ حياتها المخططة بعناية. لقاء صدفة مع جاك يُشعل شرارة قصة حب غير متوقعة تُفضي إلى اكتشاف عاطفي عميق. وبينما تختبر الأسرار وخيارات الحياة علاقتهما، يتغير مسارها إلى الأبد.

name: Descendent 2025
plot: After a traumatic brain injury triggers terrifying visions of extraterrestrials and a newfound talent for drawing, a father-to-be begins to question his reality and becomes obsessed with the need to protect his family from an unseen threat.

name: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning 2025
plot: يواصل إيثان هانت وفريقه بحثهم عن الذكاء الاصطناعي المرعب المعروف باسم \\\"الكيان\\\" - الذي تسلل إلى شبكات الاستخبارات في جميع أنحاء العالم - في مطاردة حكومات العالم وشبح غامض من ماضي هانت. ينضم إليهم حلفاء جدد، ومسلحين بالوسائل اللازمة للقضاء على \\\"الكيان\\\" نهائيًا، ويخوض هانت سباقًا مع الزمن لمنع العالم كما نعرفه من التغيير إلى الأبد.

name: Night Always Comes 2025
plot: تُخاطر لينيت بكل شيء لتأمين المنزل الذي يُمثل مستقبل عائلتها. في رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر خلال ليلة واحدة، تُجبر لينيت على مواجهة ماضيها المظلم لتُحرر نفسها أخيرًا.

name: The Siege at Thorn High 2025
plot: Edwin promised to his sister on her death bed to find her son she gave up long time ago. Edwin's quest brought him to become a substitute teacher in Duri High School, Jakarta, a school for juvenile delinquents. There he must face the most violent students to find his nephew. When he eventually finds the boy, a city-wide riot erupts and Edwin is trapped im the school with the cruel kids out for his blood.

name: Superman 2025
plot: ينطلق سوبرمان، وهو صحفي في متروبوليس، في رحلة للتوفيق بين تراثه الكريبتوني ونشأته البشرية باسم كلارك كينت.

name: Songs from the Hole 2024
plot: Sentenced to life in prison at 15, musician JJ'88 finds hope by writing songs during solitary confinement in this award-winning documentary visual album.

name: Mouseboat Massacre 2025
plot: The story follows a young woman battling a drug addiction who suddenly begins to see a mutated mouse human hybrid who infests her life. Those around her begin to drop like flies.

name: Leprechaun The Beginning 2025
plot: A family discovers a treasure box of gold in their late father's house. What seems like a dream come true turns into a nightmare as, one by one, they are stalked and killed by the real owner of the gold, the mischievous and deadly Leprechaun.

name: Conjuring Tapes 2025
plot: While sorting through their late friend's belongings, two women discover VHS tapes showing them in haunting, unfamiliar scenes, each one drawing them into the grasp of a mysterious, malevolent entity.

name: Blood Brothers Bara Naga 2025
plot: Elite bodyguard Ariff finds himself in a deadly showdown when he is framed for a crime and his best friend Ghaz turns into his fiercest adversary.

name: Bait 2025
plot: On their way to a family get-together, the Herring family are in a bad car accident, waking in a terrifying, dark basement. Something is there with them. Caged. And it craves human flesh. With a mysterious overseer aiding the creature like a pet, the family must work together to find a way to defeat them both and make their escape.

name: Barrons Cove 2024
plot: عندما يُقتل ابنه الصغير بوحشية على يد زميل له في الفصل، يقوم الأب الحزين ذو التاريخ العنيف باختطاف الطفل المسؤول عن الجريمة، مما يشعل مطاردة محمومة يغذيها سياسي قوي - والد الصبي المختطف.

name: Saint Ex 2024
plot: تعود بنا القصة إلى عام ١٩٣٠، وتتمحور حول أنطوان دو سانت إكزوبيري، طيار في البريد الجوي بالأرجنتين. عندما يختفي صديقه المقرب، هنري غيوميه، أفضل طيار في البريد الجوي، في جبال الأنديز، يقرر سانت إكزوبيري الانطلاق في رحلة بحث عنه، متحديًا كل الصعاب. تُجبره هذه المهمة المستحيلة على تجاوز حدوده، مُحوّلًا قدرته على الحلم إلى أعظم نقاط قوته...

name: Eddington 2025
plot: In May of 2020, a standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in Eddington, New Mexico.

name: Sweeney Todd: Slice & Dice 2025
plot: لندن، ١٨٤٦: كان الحلاق الناجح، سويني تود، يطارده لسنوات فقدان والديه على يد قاضٍ قاسٍ. في ليلةٍ مصيرية، يلتقي بخبازةٍ محلية، السيدة لوفيت، وهي امرأةٌ عانت هي الأخرى من ظلمٍ مدمرٍ على يد القاضي نفسه وشركائه الفاسدين. في سعيهما لوضع حدٍّ مميتٍ لدائرة الإساءة والاستغلال، عقد تود ولوفيت اتفاقًا، وهي التي تقود حملةً للانتقام الدموي، بأبشع الطرق.

name: Stolen: Heist of the Century 2025
plot: Antwerp, 2003. A gang of thieves rob the impenetrable Diamond Center. Who was behind one of the world's biggest heists - and how did they pull it off?

name: Site 2025
plot: بعد مواجهة مرعبة في موقع اختبار حكومي مهجور، يبدأ رجل عائلة من بلدة صغيرة في رؤية رؤى مرعبة عن الماضي تهدد بتدمير حاضره.

name: Shaman 2025
plot: A Missionary converting an Indigenous Community in a remote Ecuadorian volcano must come to terms with her own Faith when her son is possessed by dark forces older than her own religion.

name: Together 2025
plot: With a move to the countryside already testing the limits of a couple's relationship, a supernatural encounter begins an extreme transformation of their love, their lives, and their flesh.

name: The Occupant 2025
plot: Desperate to save her sister, Abby takes a dangerous job in the remote Georgian wilderness. Stranded in the mountains after her helicopter crashes, she finds hope through John, a mysterious helper radioing from nearby. As he guides her through the harsh conditions, Abby struggles to survive, and her grip on reality falters until she is faced with an impossible choice.

name: Hostile Takeover 2025
plot: Follows Pete, a professional hitman, as he faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings.

name: Holy Night Demon Hunters 2025
plot: When a devil-worshipping criminal network plunges Seoul into chaos, the police turn to Holy Night—a trio of supernatural demon hunters—to restore order and defeat the rising evil.

name: Harvest 2024
plot: Walt is a farmer living in a tiny rural village in Scotland. A former townsman, he is a rare outsider in an intensely xenophobic community, but has managed to slowly integrate, aided by a childhood friendship with bumbling Master Kent, who rules the village with inept benevolence. Since anyone can remember, the villagers have lived humbly but sustainably, hard seasons working the fields punctuated by cathartic drunken feasts. This relative contentment is shattered, however, by the arrival of a series of strangers – a map-maker commissioned to chart the land; three migrants fleeing a crisis; and an aristocratic company man determined to improve the efficiency of Kent's operations. The villagers respond to these arrivals with violence, the escalating consequences of which soon threaten their community's very existence.

name: The Pickup 2025
plot: A routine cash pickup takes a wild turn when mismatched armored truck drivers Russell and Travis are ambushed by ruthless criminals led by savvy mastermind Zoe.

name: Abrahams Boys- A Dracula Story 2025
plot: بعد أحداث دراكولا، ينقل أبراهام فان هيلسينج ولديه، ماكس ورودي، إلى الولايات المتحدة في محاولة للهروب من ماضيهما. لكن دون جدوى.

name: Jurassic World Rebirth 2025
plot: بعد خمس سنوات من أحداث فيلم \\\"جوراسيك وورلد دومينيون\\\"، تُكلَّف خبيرة العمليات السرية زورا بينيت بقيادة فريق ماهر في مهمة سرية للغاية لتأمين مادة وراثية من أضخم ثلاثة ديناصورات في العالم. عندما تتقاطع عملية زورا مع عائلة مدنية انقلبت رحلتها البحرية، يجدون أنفسهم جميعًا عالقين على جزيرة حيث يواجهون اكتشافًا صادمًا ومخيفًا ظلَّ مخفيًا عن العالم لعقود.

name: The Last Gunfight 2025
plot: في بطولة سرية لا هوادة فيها، يقاتل أفضل قتلة العالم حتى الموت. لكن يختبئ بينهم عصابة مارقة لها أجندتها القاتلة الخاصة: التسلل إلى المنافسة، والنجاة من حمام الدم، والقضاء على العقل المدبر الذي يحرك الخيوط.

name: Bob Trevino Likes It 2024
plot: تُصادق ليلي تريفينو فجأةً غريبًا على الإنترنت يحمل اسم والدها الأناني. قد يُغيّر دعم بوب تريفينو الجديد حياتها.

name: Trouble Man 2025
plot: جاكسن، شرطي سابق تحول إلى محقق خاص في أتلانتا، يُكلَّف بمهمة البحث عن نجمة الآر أند بي المفقودة جاهري. يكشف تحقيقاته أن اختفائها مرتبط بمؤامرة أكبر، مما يدفعه إلى التشكيك في من حوله وفي ماضيه.

name: Ghost Killer 2024
plot: After being possessed by the ghost of vengeful hitman Kudo, college student Fumika Matsuoka agrees to help him finish his quest for revenge from beyond the grave.

name: F Plus 2025
plot: تخطط مجموعة من المراهقين الشباب لعملية سرقة مثالية من خلال اقتحام مدرستهم المتوسطة لتغيير درجات اختباراتهم الفاشلة.

name: King Ivory 2024
plot: Based on extensive research involving law enforcement and gang members, a never-before-seen, authentic look inside the underworld of fentanyl trafficking from gangs inside the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester a.k.a. "Big Mac."

name: Lilim 2025
plot: Evading the police, Issa and her brother Tomas seek shelter in a secluded orphanage in the forest. But the siblings’ safe haven soon reveals itself to be a hellscape controlled by a sacrificial cult in thrall to a fearsome nocturnal deity.

name: My Oxford Year 2025
plot: An ambitious American fulfilling her dream of studying at Oxford falls for a charming Brit hiding a secret that may upend her perfectly planned life.

name: Return To Wickensburg 2024
plot: Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. It's a race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands.

name: The Mountain 2024
plot: Successful news anchor Melanie Abraxas is blindsided by her husband on the same day the teleprompters fail, leading to a very public embarrassment.

name: The Noisy Mansion 2025
plot: Nothing is more frightening, as the narrator points out, than a ‘time-rich nosy person’. Exhibit A is Ahn Geo-ul, who commits herself to social justice causes with terrifying tenacity. After temporarily renting a unit in the Baek-sae Apartment building, she discovers that a loud, hard to locate banging noise occurs from 4am every night, making the residents’ lives an insomniac hell – and so she determines to engage in her own disruption and to find the culprit of this acoustic assault, simultaneously eliminating her eccentric neighbours as suspects, and recruiting them to her cause.

name: Lyvias House 2024
plot: When a young journalist suspects the disappearance of a beautiful artist is connected to murders that took place 20 years earlier, she uncovers a reality she never could have imagined. Inspired by true events.

name: Hot Milk 2025
plot: Rose and her daughter Sofia travel to the Spanish seaside town of Almería to consult with the shamanic Dr. Gomez, a physician who could possibly hold the cure to Rose’s mystery illness, which has left her bound to a wheelchair. But in the sultry atmosphere of this sun-bleached town Sofia, who has been trapped by her mother’s illness all her life, finally starts to shed her inhibitions, enticed by the persuasive charms of enigmatic traveller Ingrid.

name: An Honest Life 2025
plot: When a cynical law student in search of inspiration joins a band of anarchists, he becomes entangled in a web of crime where he is more pawn than player.

name: War of the Worlds 2025
plot: Will Radford is a top analyst for Homeland Security who tracks potential threats through a mass surveillance program, until one day an attack by an unknown entity leads him to question whether the government is hiding something from him... and from the rest of the world.

name: The Monster Beneath Us 2024
plot: Yorkshire, 1898. A grieving woman and her son move back to the unoccupied house of her ex husband, recently found dead, but they discover that they are not alone inside the house.

name: The Life of Chuck 2024
plot: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.

name: 28 Years Later 2025
plot: Twenty-eight years since the rage virus escaped a biological weapons laboratory, now, still in a ruthlessly enforced quarantine, some have found ways to exist amidst the infected. One such group lives on a small island connected to the mainland by a single, heavily-defended causeway. When one member departs on a mission into the dark heart of the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors as well.

name: The Dogs 2025
plot: بعد فراره من والده المريض نفسياً، يلجأ شاب مراهق ووالدته إلى مزرعة نائية، فقط لمواجهة مجموعة من الكلاب الشرسة والأرواح الشريرة التي تطارد الممتلكات.

name: The Three Investigators and The Carpathian Dog 2025
plot: A call for help from gallery owner Mr. Prentice leads the three detectives into a new adventure: his apartment is said to be haunted. When the Carpathian dog, a valuable work of art, is also stolen, events spiral out of control because all the residents have a motive. As the suspects are eliminated one by one, the three detectives find themselves in the middle of their most exciting case yet.

name: Kardes Takimi 2 2025
plot: في الجزء الثاني من السلسلة، نجح أربعة أشقاء في اجتياز تدريب والديهم الصارم وأصبحوا عملاء حقيقيين. عندما يطلب صاحب علامة تجارية شهيرة لعصير الفاكهة المساعدة، تبدأ مغامرة جديدة لفريق الأشقاء. وقعت وصفة عصير الفاكهة في أيدي شرير يريد أن يجعل جميع الأطفال تعساء مثله باستخدام خليطه السري. هذه المرة، يجب على الأم والأب والأشقاء - العائلة بأكملها - العمل معًا لمواجهة هذه المهمة الصعبة. يستخدم فريق الأشقاء، إلى جانب والديهم، قوة الحب والذكاء لإيقاف كوبي. لم يوقفوا كوبي فحسب، بل أخرجوا أيضًا الخير بداخله. في النهاية، يكتشفون مفاجأة من والدتهم. لم يعد فريق الأشقاء أربعة أشخاص، بل خمسة أشخاص. شقيقهم الجديد في الطريق.

name: Late Shift 2025
plot: An entirely ordinary day on the beds ward of a surgical department. The nursing team is understaffed due to a shortage of personnel. Despite the hectic environment, Floria cares for her patients with expertise and full dedication. Although she gives her all, the shift gradually spirals out of control – until it eventually leads to a dramatic outburst.

name: Osiris 2025
plot: Special Forces commandos on a mission are abducted mid-operation by a mysterious spacecraft. Upon waking aboard, they find themselves prey to a relentless alien race in a fight for survival.

name: Control Room 2025
plot: A distant space colony where Olivia and her colleague Arlo is in charge of the colony's control room, ensuring the safety and well-being of the community. But the colony comes under siege from alien creatures.

name: Forgive Us All 2025
plot: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus has transformed humans into violently deranged cannibals. A bereaved mother has lost everything and takes refuge in an isolated mountain cabin, until a desperate wounded stranger arrives with a story of hope.

name: Faith in the Flames The Nichole Jolly Story 2025
plot: Nichole Jolly is a nurse at the town’s hospital, who begins her day as usual, only to face an unimaginable crisis when a wildfire rapidly engulfs the town. Torn between her duty to protect her patients and her desperate need to find her husband Nick, (Colin Moss) and children, Nichole discovers an unyielding strength within herself to save not only her family but countless residents from the encroaching flames. The film is a tribute to the indomitable human spirit and the unsung heroes who emerge in the face of tragedy.

name: Det Andet Offer 2025
plot: في ظل نقص الكادر الطبي في وحدة السكتات الدماغية، تُختبر ثقة طبيبة الأعصاب الماهرة ألكسندرا الراسخة في أقصى درجات الاختبار عندما تتحول حالة روتينية إلى مأساة. يسود اللوم والذنب المستشفى، وتواجه ألكسندرا تقصيرها، وتصارع التداعيات العميقة للأحكام الطبية الخاطئة. في رحلة تأملية عميقة، نكتشف وطأة الشعور بالذنب وقوة التعاطف.

name: Monster Island 2025
plot: في المحيط الهادئ عام ١٩٤٢، تقطعت السبل بجندي ياباني وأسير حرب بريطاني على جزيرة مهجورة، يطاردهما مخلوق مميت. يجب على عدوين لدودين أن يتحدا للنجاة من المجهول.

name: Happy Gilmore 2 2025
plot: لم ينتهِ هابي جيلمور من لعبة الجولف بعد، بل على الأرجح. فمنذ اعتزاله بعد فوزه الأول ببطولة الجولة، عاد جيلمور لتمويل دروس الباليه التي تُقدمها ابنته.

name: The Light 2025
plot: صورة لعائلة عصرية بين الانهيار والبدايات الجديدة، تتعامل مع قضايا عصرنا الكبرى، في عالمٍ مضطرب. تيم، وميلينا، وتوأمهما فريدا وجون، اللذين قاربا على البلوغ، وابنهما غير الشرعي ديو - هذه هي عائلة إنجلز، التي يبدو أنها فقدت كل ما يبقيها متماسكة عندما تدخل مدبرة المنزل فرح حياتهم. تضع هذه المرأة السورية الغامضة عالم إنجلز العاطفي أمام اختبارٍ غير متوقع.

name: Daniela Forever 2025
plot: رجل يحاول التغلب على مشكلة وفاة صديقته المفاجئة في حادث وقع قبل ستة أشهر، فيقوم بالتسجيل في تجربة نوم تسمح له بإعادة بناء حياته معها من خلال استخدام الأحلام الواضحة.

name: Woken 2024
plot: Anna wakes to kind faces she doesn’t recognize and a remote island she has no memory of. She is forced to re-learn everything about herself, her husband and the baby she is carrying. But when two disfigured people arrive on the island and there is a violent altercation she discovers that the human race is close to extinction and goes searching for the truth about herself.

name: Putin 2025
plot: A portrait of a formidable political figure, unraveling the contrasting facets of an iron-fisted tyrant and a man haunted by fear.

name: In Vitro 2024
plot: On an isolated cattle farm, a couple experimenting with biotechnology have their lives upended when they discover a disturbing presence on their property.

name: 40 Acres 2024
plot: Hailey Freeman and her family are the last descendants of African American farmers who settled in rural Canada after the Civil War. In a famine-decimated near future, they now struggle to safeguard their farm, as they make one last stand against a vicious militia hell-bent on taking their 40 Acres.

name: In The Land Of Brothers 2024
plot: Three members of an extended Afghan family start their lives over in Iran as refugees, unaware they face a decades-long struggle ahead to be "at home".

name: Köln 75 2025
plot: Behind one of the best-selling jazz records of all time, Keith Jarrett’s 1975 Köln Concert, how it almost didn’t happen, and how one formidable German teenager, Vera Brandes, breaks every boundary to set the conditions for the creation of a masterpiece. Vera, still in high school when she started producing and promoting music concerts in Cologne, puts everything on the line to put on this show. But Vera believes in the power of music, and she’s never seen anyone play like Keith Jarrett before.

name: Naples to New York 2024
plot: In the immediate post-war period, amidst the rubble of a poverty-ridden Naples, two kids, Carmine and Celestina, try to survive as best they can by helping each other out. One night, they secretly board a ship bound for New York to reach Celestina’s sister, who emigrated to America several years earlier.  The two children join the many Italian emigrants seeking a new life in America and arrive in an unknown metropolis, which, after several misadventures, they will learn to call home.

name: Trainwreck P I Moms 2025
plot: This tell-all documentary investigates an early 2000s reality show about private eye moms and the drug scandal that sabotaged the series and its stars.

name: Z-O-M-B-I-E-S 4: Dawn of the Vampires 2025
plot: تشرق مغامرة جديدة لزيد وأديسون عندما تأخذ رحلتهما الصيفية البرية منعطفًا غير متوقع، فتقعان في خضم منافسة شرسة أخرى: سائرو النهار ضد مصاصي الدماء. تشتعل التوترات عندما يجد زيد وأديسون نفسيهما يعملان كمستشارين في معسكر بين الفصيلين الخارقين المتعارضين. بمساعدة إليزا وويلا، يجب عليهما إقناع العدوين اللدودين نوفا وفيكتور بمحاولة توحيد عالميهما المتحاربين قبل أن يُهددهم خطر أكبر.

name: Materialists 2025
plot: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

name: Gazer 2024
plot: Frankie, a young mother with dyschronometria, struggles to perceive time. Using cassette tapes for guidance, she takes a risky job from a mysterious woman to support her family, unaware of the dark consequences that await.

name: Dangerous Animals 2025
plot: A savvy and free-spirited surfer is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer. Held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

name: Inside 2024
plot: لص أعمال فنية عالق في شقة فاخرة في نيويورك بعد فشل سرقته. محبوسًا في الداخل، لا يملك سوى أعمال فنية لا تُقدر بثمن، عليه أن يستخدم كل ما لديه من دهاء وابتكار لينجو.

name: Six Days in August 2025
plot: مات النبي جوزيف سميث، قُتل على يد حشد من الناس. يعتقد أعداء كنيسة يسوع المسيح لقديسي الأيام الأخيرة أن الكنيسة ستموت مع جوزيف. في الواقع، هذا الخطر وارد. الأزمة لا يمكن إنكارها، والقديسون في نافو في حالة من الفوضى.

name: No Address 2025
plot: مجموعة من الأفراد يقعون فجأةً في فخ التشرد. يترابطون كعائلة غير تقليدية، يكافحون من أجل البقاء في الشوارع، بينما يصدّون عصابةً مُزعجة، ومجتمعًا لا يرحم، والسلطات المحلية.

name: Bride Hard 2025
plot: سام عميلة سرية، أصعب مهمة لها حتى الآن هي إرضاء صديقتها المقربة في حفل زفاف فاخر. عندما يقتحم فريق من المرتزقة الحفل ويأخذون الضيوف رهائن، تجد سام نفسها في معركة لم تشهدها من قبل - معركة لا يمكنها فيها المخاطرة بكشف هويتها أو إفساد اليوم الكبير. وبينما تواجه الأشرار في معركة عالية المخاطر متخفية في قالب قصة خيالية، تدرك أن التهديد الحقيقي قد يكون أقرب مما تظن.

name: Almost Family 2025
plot: A Brazilian father finds a worthy opponent when he meets his daughter's Argentine in-laws, and a trip to Bariloche becomes the stage for a fun international rivalry.

name: I′m Still a Superstar 2025
plot: This documentary explores Yurena's meteoric rise to fame as Tamara, the media frenzy she faced in the 2000s and the present-day lives of her TV rivals.

name: Fate 2025
plot: In Fate, a shy young taxi driver and public office applicant, David unexpectedly becomes the chauffeur of El Maestro a former bullfighter who comes out of retirement to recover his lost reputation. El Maestro is on a losing streak and David and his taxi bring him luck, or at least that’s what he thinks…

name: Saint Clare 2024
plot: In a small town a solitary woman is haunted by voices that lead her to assassinate ill intended people and get away with it, until her last kill sucks her down a rabbit hole riddled with corruption, trafficking and visions from the beyond.

name: Sovereign 2025
plot: Struggling single father Jerry indoctrinates his son Joe into the sovereign citizen movement, teaching him that laws are mere illusions and freedom is something you take. But, as Jerry’s ideology consumes them, they are set on a collision course with a police chief who has spent his life upholding the rules that Jerry has spent his tearing down.

name: Street Queens 2025
plot: Three formidable women, Nia, Bella, and Dragon rise to power in the male-dominated realm of organized crime. This high-stakes gangster film explores a world where ruthlessness often determines who reigns supreme.

name: M3GAN 2.0 2025
plot: بعد سرقة التكنولوجيا الأساسية لـ M3GAN وإساءة استخدامها من قبل مقاول دفاع قوي لإنشاء سلاح عسكري يُعرف باسم أميليا، أدركت جيما، مبتكرة M3GAN، أن الخيار الوحيد هو إحياء M3GAN وإعطائها بعض الترقيات، مما يجعلها أسرع وأقوى وأكثر فتكًا.

name: How to Train Your Dragon 2025
plot: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

name: A Scam Called Love 2025
plot: An ambitious chef from South Africa enters a green card marriage with a cash-strapped line cook from Atlanta. The couple journey to Cape Town to gather proof of their relationship, only to find that deceiving the government is easy compared to fooling your own family.

name: The Death of Snow White 2025
plot: بعد أن طاردتها زوجة أبيها بحثًا عن جمالها الأبدي، هربت سنو وايت إلى غابة مرعبة وانضمت إلى سبعة أقزام متعطشين للدماء، قتلة بدم بارد، بارعون في القتل الوحشي. تُختبر روحها في هذه القصة الخيالية المروعة.

name: Behave 2025
plot: بعد وفاة صديقهم، يتم نقل مجموعة من الشباب غريبي الأطوار إلى فيلا على مشارف لندن، ولكن يبدو أن كيانًا غامضًا يتبعهم إلى ملاذهم الفاخر.

name: Desperate 2025
plot: شاب ضائع وضعيف، يقع في لعبة مميتة من الإغراء والفداء، حيث لا يكون أي شيء كما يبدو عندما تفقد كل شيء، ما الذي تبقى لتخسره سوى روحك.

name: Never Blink 2025
plot: خمسة طلاب طب يكتشفون طريقة لالتقاط ما لا تراه عند الرمش، والنتائج مرعبة. رحلة مرعبة إلى عالم مرعب ستجعلك لا ترمش مرة أخرى. في غمضة عين، ستموت.
director: Christopher Saint Booth, Philip Adrian Booth

name: Spiders on a Plane 2024
plot: A group of young travellers discover their dream vacation has turned into a nightmare when an infestation of top-secret deadly spiders escapes mid-flight. When the pilots are killed by the aggressive arachnids, the group must fend for themselves against the relentless swarm and their monstrous "mother" spider, measuring a massive 5 feet.

name: Madeas Destination Wedding 2025
plot: Madea packs her best floral dresses and a whole lot of chaos when the Simmons family heads to the Bahamas for her grandniece's whirlwind wedding.

name: Cafe 404 2024
plot: في امتدادٍ قاحلٍ من الطريق السريع، كان مطعم عائلة جيمي على وشك الانقراض - إلى أن أسقطت صفقة مخدرات فاشلة كيسًا من المال في حضنه. الآن، يجب على جيمي أن يشق طريقه عبر عالم العصابات الخطير، ورجال الشرطة المريبين، وموظفيه الخونة لإنقاذ العمل الذي تشبث به طوال حياته. في مزيجٍ من الجريمة والإثارة والكوميديا ​​السوداء، يجب على جيمي وفريقه غريب الأطوار - مارا ونيكو وآبي - أن يتفوقوا على المجرمين الذين يقتربون، كل ذلك في ظل صراعهم مع رغباتهم المتزايدة في المال. إنها لعبة بقاء، حيث لا أحد يلعب بنزاهة.\\r\\n

name: Almost Cops 2025
plot: When an overeager community officer and a reckless ex-detective are forced to team up, plenty of chaos ensues on the streets of Rotterdam.

name: Aap Jaisa Koi 2025
plot: Shrirenu lives by tradition. Madhu lives unapologetically. When their paths cross, a tender romance unfolds — awkward, sweet but shadowed by patriarchy.

name: Brick 2025
plot: When a mysterious brick wall encloses their apartment building overnight, Tim and Olivia must unite with their wary neighbors to get out alive.

name: Drive Back Home 2024
plot: A conservative plumber from a small east coast village who travels to Toronto in order to get his brother out of jail after he is arrested for having sex with another man in a public park. At the insistence of their strong willed mother, the two brothers must drive the 1000 mile trip back home to New Brunswick, together - discovering each other and themselves along the way.

name: The Other 2025
plot: Unable to conceive, a couple seeks to build a family with a young orphan, survivor of tragic childhood. But their act of love turns to horror when they realize the violence in their foster's past has returned to destroy the new family.

name: Warlord 2025
plot: Revolt is on the horizon in the ancient city of Lloris, ruled with an iron fist by the merciless Sheriff and The Brute. Believing their mystical powers could help free the oppressed citizens from tyranny, a young human seeks out the aid of the reclusive elves and their legendary Warlord. However, with both sides harbouring secrets, and hiding their true motives, this tentative alliance between the humans and elves may bring about the downfall of them all.

name: Deadly Escape 2025
plot: بعد هروبها من سجن شديد الحراسة، تُصرّ فريدا ماكسويل، المُدانة بقتل والدها المُسيء، على البقاء في مأمن من القانون. عندما تختطف درو بيترسون، طالب الطب الذي يبدو بريئًا، لمساعدتها على الهرب، تأخذ خطتها منعطفًا مرعبًا. ينكشف وجه درو المهذب، ويكشف عن مفترس خطير ذي نوايا شريرة. وبينما تُكافح فريدا من أجل حريتها، تجد نفسها عالقة في صراع نفسي مع رجل ينظر إليها كبيدق في لعبته الملتوية. مع اقتراب الشرطة ودرو منها، يجب على فريدا مواجهة ماضيها المسكون واستجماع كل ذرة من إرادتها للتغلب على آسرها وكشف الحقيقة التي قد تُنقذها - أو تُنهي مصيرها إلى الأبد.

name: Lilo & Stitch 2025
plot: قصة مضحكة ومؤثرة للغاية عن فتاة هاوايية وحيدة وكائن فضائي هارب يساعدها في إصلاح أسرتها المكسورة.
director: Dean Fleischer Camp, Brian Avery Galligan

name: The Unholy Trinity 2025
plot: Set against the turbulent backdrop of 1870s Montana, in the moments before the execution of Isaac Broadway, he gives his estranged son, Henry, an impossible task: murder the man who framed him for a crime he didn’t commit. Intent on fulfilling his promise, Henry travels to the remote town of Trinity, where an unexpected turn of events traps him in town and leaves him caught between Gabriel Dove, the town’s upstanding new sheriff, and a mysterious figure named St. Christopher.

name: Karate Kid Legends 2025
plot: After a family tragedy, kung fu prodigy Li Fong is uprooted from his home in Beijing and forced to move to New York City with his mother. When a new friend needs his help, Li enters a karate competition – but his skills alone aren't enough. Li's kung fu teacher Mr. Han enlists original Karate Kid Daniel LaRusso for help, and Li learns a new way to fight, merging their two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

name: Eden 2025
plot: مجموعة من الناس مدفوعة برغبة عميقة في التغيير. ولكي يُديروا ظهرهم للمجتمع، يتركون كل شيء خلفهم ويضعون مستقبلهم في تضاريس جزر غالاباغوس القاسية.

name: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado 2025
plot: تسافر دورا ودييغو وأصدقائهم الجدد عبر المخاطر المحدقة بغابات الأمازون بحثًا عن كنز سول دورادو القديم والقوي لإبقائه بعيدًا عن أيدي العدو.

name: The Old Guard 2 2025
plot: Andy and her team of immortal warriors fight with renewed purpose as they face a powerful new foe threatening their mission to protect humanity.

name: Heads of State 2025
plot: The UK Prime Minister and US President have a public rivalry that risks their countries' alliance. But when they become targets of a powerful enemy, they're forced to rely on each other as they go on a wild, multinational run. Allied with Noel, a brilliant MI6 agent, they must find a way to thwart a conspiracy that threatens the free world.

name: Guns Up 2025
plot: When a job goes horribly wrong, an ex-cop and family man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city.

name: Ice Road Vengeance 2025
plot: يسافر مايك ماكان، سائق شاحنة كبيرة على الطرق الجليدية، إلى نيبال لنثر رماد شقيقه الراحل على جبل إيفرست. أثناء وجوده في حافلة سياحية مكتظة تعبر التضاريس الخطرة لطريق السماء الشهير، الذي يبلغ ارتفاعه 12,000 قدم، يواجه ماكان ومرشده الجبلي مجموعة من المرتزقة، ويضطران للقتال لإنقاذ نفسيهما، وحافلة المسافرين الأبرياء، وموطن القرويين المحليين.

name: Ballerina 2025
plot: Taking place during the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, Eve Macarro begins her training in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma.

name: Bring Her Back 2025
plot: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are introduced to their new sibling by their foster mother, only to learn that she has a terrifying secret.

name: Sampiyonlar 2025
plot: يذهب إيفي، البالغ من العمر ثماني سنوات، إلى إزمير مع عائلته لزيارة جده حقي. وبينما تُخطط شقيقته المحبوبة هيرا لحياةٍ مليئةٍ بالتشويق، يشعر إيفي بالملل والغربة. في السوق، يلتقي جيرين وصديقاتها، لاعبات الشطرنج الماهرات اللواتي يتحدينه في لعبة. مصممًا على إثارة إعجاب جيرين، يطلب إيفي مساعدة جده، لكن حقي يرفض، ظانًا أن إيفي سيستسلم كما فعل والده سابقًا. يشعر إيفي باليأس، فيكتشف البيدق الأبيض السحري، الذي يساعده على تعلم الشطرنج وتكوين فريق.

name: Hunting Grounds 2025
plot: Desperate to find refuge for her children, Chloe Marvino runs away from her Mafia tied husband, and finds shelter in a cabin with a recluse drifter named Jake. But as her husband's henchmen draw closer to her, it turns out that Jake is the biggest enemy of them all.

name: Tornado 2025
plot: When her father's puppet samurai show gets ambushed by a notorious gang, Tornado vows to seek vengeance and forge her own destiny by stealing their ill-gotten gold.

name: Thunderbolts 2025
plot: بعد أن وجدوا أنفسهم محاصرين في فخ الموت، يجب على سبعة من المنبوذين المحبطين الشروع في مهمة خطيرة ستجبرهم على مواجهة أظلم زوايا ماضيهم.

name: Steppenwolf 2025
plot: Tamara is searching for her missing son in a small town consumed by riots and violence. In a desperate attempt to get him back, she decides to offer a reward to an amoral former investigator whose methods prove to be sadistic. Determined, Tamara decides to complete the mission with the nihilistic detective, no matter what the cost.

name: The Ritual 2025
plot: Two priests, one in crisis with his faith and the other confronting a turbulent past, must overcome their differences to perform a risky exorcism.

name: The Last Rodeo 2025
plot: A retired rodeo legend risks it all to save his grandson. Facing his own painful past and the fears of his family, he enters a high-stakes bullriding competition as the oldest contestant ever. Along the way, he reconciles old wounds with his estranged daughter and proves that true courage is found in the fight for family.

name: Off the Grid 2025
plot: After a morally-bankrupt company tries to weaponize a brilliant scientist's revolutionary technology, he goes off the grid to safeguard humanity. When the company sends a strike force to find him, they make their biggest mistake of all – they weaponize the man they are trying to catch.

name: A Bestselling Kind Of Love 2025
plot: تشعر نورا بسعادة غامرة عندما تتصدر روايتها الأولى قائمة الكتب الأكثر مبيعًا، لكنها تشعر بالرعب من التحدث أمام الحشود للترويج لكتابها، لذلك يستعين وكيل نورا الأدبي بدانيال، مدرب التحدث أمام الجمهور، لمساعدتها في التغلب على مخاوفها، وهو أمر أسهل قولاً من فعله.

name: Green Bones 2025
plot: A soon-to-be released criminal and a corrections officer is still grieving over the death of his sister opposing the prisoner's release.

name: Ill Be Right There 2025
plot: Wanda wants to take care of everyone in her life. She barely has time for herself, not that she would know what to do with it anyway.

name: Inheritance 2025
plot: When Maya learns her father Sam was once a spy, she suddenly finds herself at the center of an international conspiracy. As she seeks answers, Maya herself becomes a target and must quickly learn the skills of her father.

name: Juliet & Romeo 2025
plot: Set in 1301 at the end of Medieval times, our most famous star-crossed lovers turn the tides on the history Shakespeare based his own story on, as they reveal the truth to the very future of the Empire. But the biggest twist in this most beloved of tales, is leaving the poetry of Iambic Pentameter in the past, for the original pop music that rockets these ever-present themes right to the heart of our characters in the most surprising, and perhaps most powerful way that has ever been seen, or heard, before... The greatest love story of all time, set to the greatest music of our time.

name: The Traitor 2024
plot: Hoping to become a great singer in Germany, a young dreamer named Ernst Schrämli finds himself drawn into underhand dealings. Determined to escape a suffocating environment that annihilates any kind of creative or artistic impetus, Ernst sells information about the Swiss army to a Nazi spy by the name of August Schmid, who charms and manipulates him. When Ernst’s crime is uncovered, he is sentenced to death for espionage and treason, becoming the first Swiss citizen to be executed.

name: Red Shoes 2025
plot: في منطقة نائية بجبال المكسيك، يعيش أرتيميو، المزارع الذي يراقب أرضه القاحلة التي يعمل بها، وحياته تتلاشى من بين يديه. عندما يتلقى خبرًا صادمًا، يقرر الانطلاق إلى المدينة بحثًا عن النجاة، لكنه يجد نفسه مضطرًا للتعامل مع عالم قاسٍ يجهله تمامًا.

name: Three Kilometres To The End Of The World 2024
plot: Adi, a gay teenager, is spending the summer in his home village in the Danube Delta. One night he is brutally attacked on the street, the next day his world is turned upside-down. His parents no longer look at him as they did, and the seeming tranquility of the village starts to crack.

name: Wilting Rose 2025
plot: A devastating storm damages Rose's house, and she is forced to go into town to seek help from an untrustworthy roofer; her past catches up to her as she replays her husband's life through an old tape recorder.

name: Tales from Black Manor 2025
plot: ادخل إلى عالم \\\"حكايات من القصر الأسود\\\" المرعب، قصة تبدأ في القرن الرابع عشر وتستمر عبر الزمن حتى نهاية العالم، متتبعةً علاقة عائلة بالموت. تتوالى الأحداث عبر الأجيال، متتبعةً عائلة بلاك وهي تمتلك كتاب موت سريًا وتبحث عن أسراره، وتخوض حروبًا ضارية سعيًا وراء الخلود.

name: Fear Below 2025
plot: A rag-tag team of divers attempting to salvage a sunken car from a river are thwarted by a highly aggressive bull shark.

name: I′m Beginning To See the Light 2025
plot: A tale of self-rediscovery seen through the eyes of a grief-stricken trumpeter, who finds salvation in a lighthouse and its two suicidal visitors.

name: Stand Your Ground 2025
plot: Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife’s murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord’s family and ending in an explosive showdown.

name: The Phoenician Scheme 2025
plot: Wealthy businessman Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

name: Grounded: Making The Last of Us
plot: A feature-length exploration of the game's creation, and a love letter to the trials of exploring new territory. There are no road maps or guide books for creating a new world. The only way through is to fail—over and over again. This is the story of how a team of artists, musicians, programmers, writers, actors, filmmakers, playtesters, and a lonely UI designer—came together and pushed each other to build something larger than themselves.

name: Grounded II- Making The Last of Us Part II
plot: Learn directly from the team at Naughty Dog about what it took to bring the acclaimed sequel The Last of Us Part II to life, with a new behind-the-scenes look at development.

name: grenfell uncovered 2025
plot: Survivors, witnesses, and experts tell the story of the tragic fire that engulfed a residential tower block in London — and the investigation that ensued.

name: Atsuko Okatsuka Father 2025
plot: Fans call her 'Mother,' but Atsuko is 'Father'—thriving professionally yet clueless about basics. A 7-year laundry hiatus and learning that marriage licenses precede weddings are just some hilariously relatable discoveries she shares in her special.

name: And Mrs 2024
plot: When a reluctant bride-to-be's fiancé drops dead, she insists on going ahead with the wedding anyway – vowing to overcome public opinion, the law of the land, and her loved one's objections.

name: A Lien 2023
plot: On the day of their green card interview, a young couple confronts a dangerous immigration process.

name: a king like me 2024
plot: Follows members of the Zulu Club, New Orleans’ first Black Mardi Gras, as they work to bring the Zulu parade back to the streets for Mardi Gras Day 2022, in the face of a global pandemic, hurricane Ida and the loss of members due to COVID and gun violence.

name: Holy Cow 2024
plot: After the tragic death of his father, 18-year-old Totone must look after his younger sister and their failing family farm. He assumes even more responsibility when he enters a cash competition for the best Comté cheese made in the western part of the French Alps.

name: Latin Blood The Ballad of Ney Matogrosso 2025
plot: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages — and himself — through music, creativity and inner fire.

name: Uninvited 2024
plot: Eva seeks revenge on billionaire Guilly for killing her daughter. Disguised, she attends his party with a vengeful plan.

name: trainwreck mayor of mayhem 2025
plot: Rob Ford scandalized Canadian politics as the brash yet beloved mayor of Toronto — until an infamous video of him smoking crack sparked his downfall.

name: The Shrouds 2024
plot: Inconsolable since the death of his wife, Karsh, a prominent businessman, invents a revolutionary and controversial technology that enables the living to monitor their dear departed in their shrouds. One night, multiple graves, including that of Karsh’s wife, are desecrated, and he sets out to track down the perpetrators.

name: surviving ohio state 2025
plot: Delves into the sexual abuse scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at The Ohio State University saw the abuse of hundreds of students, and the ongoing quest for justice and accountability by his survivors.

name: Survive 2024
plot: A couple celebrates their son’s birthday in the middle of the ocean on their boat. A violent storm hits and it brings up hungry creatures from the depths and they fight for their survival.

name: Sujo 2024
plot: When a hitman is murdered, he leaves behind Sujo, his beloved 4-year-old son. The shadow of violence stalks Sujo at every stage of his life. As he grows into a man, Sujo will discover that fulfilling his father's destiny seems inevitable.

name: Ocean with David Attenborough 2025
plot: David Attenborough takes viewers on a breathtaking journey showing there is nowhere more vital for our survival, more full of life, wonder, or surprise, than the ocean. Through spectacular sequences featuring coral reefs, kelp forests and the open ocean, Attenborough shares why a healthy ocean keeps the entire planet stable and flourishing.

name: Frozen: The Hit Broadway Musical 2025
plot: تحلم الأميرة الشابة آنا من أريندل بإيجاد الحب الحقيقي في حفل تتويج أختها إلسا. يأخذها القدر في رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر في محاولة لإنهاء الشتاء الأبدي الذي حلّ على المملكة. يرافقها عامل توصيل الثلج كريستوف، ورنة سفين، ورجل الثلج أولاف. في مغامرة ستكتشف فيها معنى الصداقة والشجاعة والعائلة والحب الحقيقي.

name: Crown of Shadows 2025
plot: The Kingdom of Aberon has fallen into darkness under Queen Ginnarra's reign since she murdered the King. Exiled and hunted, her brother Prince Elderon joins a rebellion, summoning a dragon to defeat the Queen and the Dark Gods she serves.

name: Marshmallow 2025
plot: At a secluded summer camp, timid and introverted 12-year-old Morgan is thrust into a waking nightmare when a once-fabled campfire tale becomes real. As a mysterious figure descends upon the camp, Morgan and his newfound friends must embark on a treacherous journey and uncover a sinister reality buried beneath the surface.

name: Semi-Soeter 2025
plot: Power couple Jaci and JP find themselves in a bumpy predicament when a new work pitch for a baby brand forces them to play the perfect pretend parents.

name: Fight or Flight 2025
plot: يتولى مرتزق مهمة تعقب هدف على متن طائرة ولكن يجب عليه حمايتها عندما يحيط به أشخاص يحاولون قتل كليهما.

name: Rule Breakers 2025
plot: In a nation where educating girls is seen as rebellion, a visionary woman dares to teach young minds to dream. When their innovation draws global attention, their success sparks hope—and opposition. As threats loom and sacrifices are made, their courage and unity ignite a movement that could forever transform the world.

name: The Woods 2024
plot: A woman on a true crime podcast recounts the mysterious story of a hike that resulted in the death of her best friends several years earlier.

name: Morgan- Killer Doll 2025
plot: Things go awry when Astrid doesn't share the same feelings for her longtime best friend, Darcy.

name: Legend of the Forest 2025
plot: A group of friends set out on an adventure deep into the wilderness, determined to investigate the legend of Bigfoot.

name: How to Solve Your Own Murder 2024
plot: A troubled young woman assumes her double's identity in a parallel dimension to try and solve her attempted murder.

name: Henry Johnson 2025
plot: A quiet man is abruptly arrested without explanation, thrust into a surreal legal nightmare where truth and identity blur. As he fights to assert his innocence, he confronts a chilling system that seems more interested in control than justice.

name: Diablo 2025
plot: Ex-con Kris Chaney seizes the daughter of a Colombian gangster to fulfill a noble promise to the young girl's mother. When her father enlists both the criminal underworld and a psychotic killer to exact his revenge, Kris relies on everything he's ever learned to stay alive and keep his word.

name: Echo Valley 2025
plot: Kate lives a secluded life—until her troubled daughter shows up, frightened and covered in someone else's blood. As Kate unravels the shocking truth, she learns just how far a mother will go to try to save her child.

name: Words of War 2025
plot: World-renowned journalist and human rights activist Anna Politkovskaya went from being a local print journalist to braving the Chechen killing fields and exposing Russian state corruption under Vladimir Putin. She refused to give up reporting on the war in Chechnya despite numerous acts of intimidation and violence, including being poisoned. She was ultimately murdered in the elevator of her block of flats and it remains unclear who paid for the contract killing.

name: Marked Men: Rule + Shaw 2025
plot: أحبت شو لاندون رول آرتشر منذ أن وقعت عيناها عليه. رول، فنانة وشم متمردة حادة الطباع، لا تملك وقتًا لفتاة مطيعة مثل شو، حتى لو كانت الوحيدة التي ترى شخصيته الحقيقية. تعيش وفقًا لقواعد الآخرين، بينما يضع هو قواعده الخاصة. لكن تنورة قصيرة، ومشروبات كوكتيل كثيرة في أعياد الميلاد، وأسرار مُفصح عنها، تُفضي إلى ليلة لا يُنسى. الآن، على شو ورول أن يكتشفا كيف يُفترض أن يكون فتاة مثلها وشاب مثله معًا دون أن يُدمرا حبهما... أو بعضهما البعض.

name: Sew Torn 2025
plot: تتورط خياطة في خيطها الخاص بعد سرقة حقيبة من صفقة مخدرات فاشلة. في لعبة قط وفأر متصاعدة، تؤدي خياراتها المختلفة إلى نتائج مختلفة تمامًا على طول الطريق.

name: Bleeding 2025
plot: In a world where vampire blood is harvested as a drug, two desperate teenagers on the run from a vicious dealer break into an empty house and find a sleeping girl locked inside.

name: Bogieville 2025
plot: A young couple on the run come across a derelict trailer park called Bogieville. Convinced to stay by the sinister caretaker, they soon learn that he is a guardian to the Bogievillians, a pack of vampires.

name: Cheer to Life 2025
plot: Jéssica is a simple young woman, dedicated to her job at an antique shop in Rio de Janeiro, but she feels her life lacks purpose. Everything changes when she finds a mysterious locket identical to an item she inherited from her late mother. Driven by the desire to understand the connection between the locket and her family history, Jéssica teams up with Gabriel, a distant relative who appears unexpectedly.

name: Deep Cover 2025
plot: Kat is an improv comedy teacher beginning to question if she’s missed her shot at success. When an undercover cop offers her the role of a lifetime, she recruits two of her students to infiltrate London’s gangland by impersonating dangerous criminals.

name: Friendship 2025
plot: Suburban dad Craig falls hard for his charismatic new neighbor Austin, as Craig’s attempts to make an adult male friend threaten to ruin both of their lives.

name: Titan The OceanGate Disaster 2025
plot: انفجرت غواصة تيتان السياحية التابعة لشركة أوشن جيت عام ٢٠٢٣ أثناء غوصها في أعماق البحار على متن سفينة تيتانيك. يروي هذا الفيلم الوثائقي كيف انتهت هذه الرؤية الجريئة بمأساة.

name: The Fire and the Moth 2025
plot: تبدأ أعمال العنف والفوضى بعد هروب أحد المهربين برأس برونزي نادر من إيف إلى بلدة نيجيرية غربية قاحلة.

name: The Death That Awaits 2025
plot: A drifter searching for answers to a mystery from her past takes on a job looking after a sick teen who is undergoing a mysterious transformation her family will do anything to stop.

name: Irish Ashes 2025
plot: When the son of an infamous Irish mobster returns home for the internment of his Mother's ashes, he discovers his sister is missing. Tristan McGowan tracks down the gang responsible for her kidnapping and uncovers a dark family secret.

name: Clown in a Cornfield 2025
plot: Quinn and her father have just moved to the quiet town of Kettle Springs hoping for a fresh start. Instead, she discovers a fractured community that has fallen on hard times after the treasured Baypen Corn Syrup Factory burned down. As the locals bicker amongst themselves and tensions boil over, a sinister, grinning figure emerges from the cornfields to cleanse the town of its burdens, one bloody victim at a time.

name: The Amateur 2025
plot: بعد أن تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تُقتل زوجته في هجوم إرهابي في لندن، يتولى فك تشفير وكالة المخابرات المركزية الأمريكية اللامع ولكنه انطوائي زمام الأمور بنفسه عندما يرفض رؤساؤه اتخاذ أي إجراء.

name: Spit 2025
plot: Spitteri finds himself locked up in an immigration detention centre upon his return to Australia. With old enemies on his tail and a target on his back, he navigates a series of comedic misadventures, sharing with his fellow detainees the meaning of mateship and what it is to be truly Australian.

name: Saint Catherine 2025
plot: An orphaned girl is rescued from a satanic ritual and taken to Saint Catherine Institute for homeless youth. There she will learn new skills while facing demons that stalk her.

name: Restless 2025
plot: When hard partying and volatile neighbours move in next door, a quiet woman's life begins to spiral, pushing her to the edge and triggering a slow, unnerving descent into obsession and revenge.

name: Mountainhead 2025
plot: A group of billionaire friends get together against the backdrop of a rolling international crisis.

name: Amongst The Wolves 2025
plot: On the streets of Dublin, Danny, a homeless man grappling with the ghosts of his past, finds himself caught in a cycle of despair and survival. Haunted by memories of his time serving in the Royal Irish Army, Danny's life takes a turn when he encounters Will, a young teenager on the run from a dangerous drug gang.

name: The Surfer 2025
plot: A man returns to the idyllic beach of his childhood to surf with his son. When he is humiliated by a group of locals, the man is drawn into a conflict that keeps rising and pushes him to his breaking point.

name: Hurry Up Tomorrow 2025
plot: A musician plagued by insomnia is pulled into an odyssey with a stranger who begins to unravel the very core of his existence.

name: The Good Half 2025
plot: يعود رين ويلاند إلى منزله في كليفلاند لحضور جنازة والدته. وفور وصوله، يُنشئ علاقات جديدة ويُداوي علاقات قديمة، قبل أن يواجه مشاكله ويحاول تجاوز حزنه.

name: The Neverending Wedding 2025
plot: عندما يلتقي بول المرح مع وصيفة الشرف المترددة لونا بالصدفة في حفل زفاف مغربي، تصبح الأمور معقدة عندما يجدان نفسيهما غير قادرين على الهروب من مكان الحفل أو من نفسيهما أو من بعضهما البعض.

name: The Accountant 2 2025
plot: عندما يُقتل أحد معارفه القدامى، يُجبر وولف على حل القضية. إدراكًا منه لضرورة اتخاذ إجراءات أكثر صرامة، يستعين بشقيقه المنفصل عنه والشديد الخطورة، براكس، للمساعدة. وبالتعاون مع ماريبيث ميدينا، يكشفان مؤامرةً قاتلة، ويصبحان هدفًا لشبكةٍ من القتلة عديمي الرحمة الذين لن يترددوا في فعل أي شيء لإخفاء أسرارهم.

name: Shadow of Vengeance 2025
plot: دوس جونز، جندي سابق في قوات النخبة البحرية الأمريكية وحائز على وسام الشرف المرموق، يُدفع إلى حافة الهاوية عندما يُطلق سراح قاتل والدته مبكرًا من السجن وتُضرب ابنة أخته بشدة. انتقامًا لدماء الأبرياء، يقرر دوس أن يأخذ القانون على عاتقه ويُنظف الشوارع واحدًا تلو الآخر.

name: Shadow Force 2025
plot: Kyrah and Isaac were once the leaders of a multinational special forces group called Shadow Force. They broke the rules by falling in love, and in order to protect their son, they go underground. With a large bounty on their heads, and the vengeful Shadow Force hot on their trail, one family's fight becomes all-out war.

name: Graduation Trip Mallorca 2025
plot: 2021. After spending a year in confinement, a group of high school students and their two teachers begin an end-of-year trip to Mallorca. This great plan is the last opportunity they have to all be together, make up for lost time, be able to have fun like they have never had before and say goodbye to this crazy stage of their lives. However, a new coronavirus outbreak disrupts all their plans and forces them to stay locked in their hotel rooms. More than 50 students, 2 teachers, a hotel and many, many minibars... What could go wrong?

name: bono stories of surrender 2025
plot: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.

name: The Quiet Ones 2025
plot: In 2008, a group of men from Denmark and across Europe pull off the biggest heist of all time on Danish soil. Kasper, a boxer with few chances left in life, is offered the opportunity to plan the robbery by its foreign initiators.

name: The Royal We 2025
plot: When her older sister elopes with a non-royal, Princess Bea who has lived her life away from her royal duties must now step in and honor the arranged marriage to a small kingdom prince.

name: Sinners 2025
plot: في محاولة لترك حياتهم المضطربة خلفهم، يعود شقيقان توأم إلى مسقط رأسهما لبدء حياتهما من جديد، فقط ليكتشفا أن شرًا أعظم ينتظرهما للترحيب بهما مرة أخرى.

name: a deadly american marriage 2025
plot: Murder or self-defense? Told from both sides, this documentary explores the killing of Jason Corbett during a dispute with his wife and her father.

name: All India Rank 2025
plot: فيفيك يبلغ من العمر سبعة عشر عامًا، وكما تشهد كل عائلة من الطبقة المتوسطة في الهند، فقد حان الوقت للتسجيل في دورات تدريبية لامتحانات القبول في المعاهد الهندية للتكنولوجيا (IITs) المعروفة بتنافسيتها الشديدة. والد فيفيك، الذي يعتبر شهادة المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا شهادة أخلاقية، يرسل ابنه الوحيد إلى مدرسة داخلية تحضيرية في كوتا، قبلة التدريب على المعاهد الهندية للتكنولوجيا. على مدار عامين، يمر فيفيك بفترة المراهقة الهندية، لكن والديه هما من يتولى مسؤولية نموه.

name: The Apartment 2025
plot: Bud Baxter is a minor clerk in a huge New York insurance company, until he discovers a quick way to climb the corporate ladder. He lends out his apartment to the executives as a place to take their mistresses. Although he often has to deal with the aftermath of their visits, one night he's left with a major problem to solve.

name: karol g tomorrow was beautiful 2025
plot: Karol G pulls back the curtain on her rise to stardom while navigating a sold-out stadium tour, creating new music and releasing a new album.

name: La Cocina 2025
plot: في المطبخ الخلفي الحار لمطعم في تايمز سكوير، يجد بيدرو، الطاهي غير الموثق، نفسه عالقًا بين ضغوط العمل المتزايدة وقصة حب معقدة مع النادلة جوليا. عندما يختفي المال، تنتشر الشكوك، مما يُشعل توترات تهدد بتقويض آمال الموظفين الهشة.

name: My sunshine 2025
plot: تحكي My Sunshine قصة تجربة في المدرسة الثانوية مليئة بالحب والصداقة، وهي موضوعات تتردد صداها بعمق لدى عشاق الدراما الكورية بينما تتجذر بقوة في بيئة نيجيرية.

name: the luckiest man in america 2025
plot: 1984; Michael Larson, an unemployed ice-cream truck driver from Ohio, steps onto the game show "Press Your Luck" harboring a secret: the key to endless amounts of money. But his winning streak is threatened when the executives in the control room start to uncover his real motivations.

name: The Most Precious Of Cargoes 2025
plot: Once upon a time, a poor woodcutter and his wife lived in a great forest. Cold, hunger, poverty, and a war raging all around them meant their lives were very hard.  One day, the woodcutter's wife rescues a baby. A baby girl thrown from one of the many trains that constantly pass through the forest. This baby, this "most precious of cargoes", will transform the lives of the poor woodcutter's wife and her husband, as well as those whose paths the child will cross—including the man who threw her from the train. And some will try to protect her, whatever the cost. Their story will reveal the worst and the best in the hearts of men.

name: The Jolly Monkey 2025
plot: 40 years ago, families disappeared near the isolated Jolly Monkey motel. Today, the family of the owners return to discuss what to do with the place. One by one they are killed by a someone dressed as the motel's mascot and need to escape.

name: Carjackers 2025
plot: By day, they're invisible—valets, hostesses, and bartenders at a luxury hotel. By night, they're the Carjackers, a crew of skilled drivers who track and rob wealthy clients on the road. As they plan their ultimate heist, the hotel director hires a ruthless hitman, to stop them at all costs. With danger closing in, can Nora, Zoe, Steve, and Prestance pull off their biggest score yet?

name: Abduct 2025
plot: A woman's peaceful mountain getaway takes a bizarre turn when her boyfriend disappears, and a random naked man shows up claiming to be him.

name: The Devils Bride 2025
plot: Caught in a strained marriage, Echa finds solace in a man who visits her dreams. But comfort turns to terror when he emerges as a malicious spirit.

name: The Surrender 2025
plot: A fraught mother-daughter relationship is put to a terrifying test when the family patriarch dies, and the grieving mother hires a mysterious stranger to bring her husband back from the dead.

name: Until Dawn 2025
plot: بعد عام من اختفاء أختها ميلاني الغامض، تتجه كلوفر وأصدقاؤها إلى الوادي النائي الذي اختفت فيه بحثًا عن إجابات. وبينما يستكشفون مركز زوار مهجورًا، يجدون أنفسهم مطاردين من قبل قاتل مُقنّع، ويُقتلون بوحشية واحدًا تلو الآخر... ليستيقظوا ليجدوا أنفسهم قد عادوا في بداية المساء نفسه.

name: Project MKHEXE 2025
plot: Tim films his brother Sean's funeral after his suicide, then uncovers Sean's fixation with a nonexistent online urban legend about a failed government mind control experiment.

name: Pale Horse 2025
plot: يجتمع الفن والحب والسحر الأسود معًا في هذه الحكاية القوطية التي تحكي عن رجل غريب الأطوار يستدعي روحًا انتقامية لتحقيق رغباته وجعله فنانًا عظيمًا.

name: Fountain of Youth 2025
plot: A treasure-hunting mastermind assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he'll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister.

name: Fear Street- Prom Queen 2025
plot: Who will be voted queen at Shadyside High's 1988 prom? For underdog Lori, competition is cutthroat even before someone starts killing off the candidates.

name: A Joint Custody Christmas 2025
plot: مع اقتراب موسم الأعياد، يواجه زوجان متطلقان حكمًا قضائيًا من شأنه أن يقلب حياة أسرتهما رأسًا على عقب ويضع احتفالات عيد الميلاد في خطر شديد.

name: Altered Reality 2025
plot: Oliver's life transforms with an alien-marked miracle drug, riches, family woes, and a vanished daughter in 'Altered Reality'—a gripping tale of redemption and choices.

name: Viridian 2025
plot: A family hunting trip goes awry when a stranger in the woods is accidentally shot. As each family member denies responsibility, they begin to suspect that it wasn’t an accident after all.

name: Soul to Squeeze 2025
plot: Jacob's got problems-deep, mental ones. Desperate for relief, he volunteers for a radical treatment to escape his tortured mind. But instead of peace, he finds himself trapped in a house with a tunnel to his subconscious. What begins as a path to healing becomes a harrowing descent where memory fractures, time distorts, and reality bends. A first-of-its-kind cinematic experience, Soul to Squeeze begins in a boxy 4:3 aspect ratio and ever so slowly widens to a full 2.35:1 by the final frame-mirroring Jacob's expanding perception as he risks everything for redemption. Visually daring and emotionally raw, Soul to Squeeze merges body with mind, taking audiences on a perilous journey through the psyche.

name: Forever Young 2025
plot: At the end of the 1980s, Stella, Victor, Adèle and Etienne are 20 years old. They take the entrance exam to the famous acting school created by Patrice Chéreau and Pierre Romans at the Théâtre des Amandiers in Nanterre. Launched at full speed into life, passion, and love, together they will experience the turning point of their lives, but also their first tragedy.

name: Flintoff 2025
plot: Looks back at Andrew 'Freddie' Flintoff’s incredible life and cricketing career that saw him win two Ashes series with England and become a national sporting hero, whilst charting his life today and return to cricket following his life-altering car crash in 2022.

name: The Legend of Ochi 2025
plot: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear an elusive animal species known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

name: Rosario 2025
plot: Wall Street stockbroker Rosario Fuentes returns to her grandmother's apartment after her sudden death. While sorting through her belongings, Rosario discovers a hidden chamber that's filled with occult artifacts tied to dark generational rituals. As supernatural occurrences begin to plague her, she must confront her family's buried secrets and face the truth about the sacrifices and choices they made.

name: Depart from It 2025
plot: An old friend's death forces now escort and drug carrier Alexes Mows to go back to her hometown and face a past that she has tried to leave behind. But when secret demons catch up with her, she must make a decision between life and death.

name: Alien Invasion- Rise of the Phoenix 2025
plot: An asteroid shower lands in a remote section of the Grand Canyon and begins to spread mysterious pods. Meanwhile, scientists on a space station that has been hit by the same asteroid shower, discover that a pod has mutated into a creature and is threatening the ship. Now the scientists and a team on Earth must learn to defeat this alien force, fighting fire with fire, fighting stone with stone.

name: Guy Manley – A Real Movie 2025
plot: جاي مانلي، العميل السري الأبرز في العالم سابقًا، والذي، بينما كان غارقًا في تقاعده المُثقل بالكحول، أُعيد إلى منصبه في مهمة أخيرة على يد رئيسه السابق باك كاش. مهمته؟ قتل شقيق باك، ريتش كاش، ومنعه من الفوز بمنصب عمدة المدينة، وبالتالي منعه من أن يصبح أقوى رجل في العالم!

name: Marching Powder 2025
plot: Middle-aged Jack, arrested for drugs, strives in six weeks to repair his marriage, curb a bullying in-law, and guide his stepbrother in the right direction, but all efforts fail as his life spirals further out of control.

name: A Breed Apart 2025
plot: When Violet accepts an invitation to a private island with some of the world's most famous social influencers, she expects a weekend of unrivaled viral opportunity. She soon becomes part of her own horrific reality show when the guests are pitted against each other to capture the island's legendary man-eating dogs before they become victims of the monstrous canines.

name: Everyone is Going to Die 2025
plot: On his daughter's birthday, a wealthy father's reconciliation attempt is hijacked by two female burglars. A shakedown evolves into a lethal cat-and-mouse as hidden motives emerge, culminating in a life-altering revelation.

name: Beating Hearts 2025
plot: Local rebellious teenager Clotaire falls for his schoolmate Jackie, but gang violence leads him to a darker destructive path. After years apart, the star-crossed lovers discover that every path they've taken leads them back together.

name: Final Destination Bloodlines 2025
plot: بعد أن عانت من كابوس عنيف متكرر، تعود طالبة الجامعة ستيفاني إلى منزلها لتعقب الشخص الوحيد الذي قد يكون قادرًا على كسر هذه الدائرة وإنقاذ عائلتها من الموت المروع الذي ينتظرهم جميعًا حتمًا.

name: Catalyst 2025
plot: يُختطف سبعة رجال ويحتجزهم خاطفون ملثمون غامضون. ومع انكشاف لغز أسرهم، عليهم أن يقرروا مصيرهم: إما أن يختاروا أحدهم ليموت، أو أن يغامروا بالإيمان بوجود مخرج آخر لإنقاذهم جميعًا.

name: Mr. K 2025
plot: السيد ك، الساحر المتجول، يجد نفسه في كابوس كافكاو عندما لا يستطيع العثور على مخرج الفندق الذي نام فيه. محاولاته للخروج فقط تجذبه إلى أبعد من ذلك، وتجعله متشابكًا أكثر مع الفندق وسكانه الفضوليين.

name: Queen Of The Ring 2025
plot: In a time when pro wrestling for women was illegal all over the country, a small town single mother embraces the danger to change culture as she dominates America's most masculine sport to become the first million dollar female athlete in history.

name: Snow White 2025
plot: بعد اختفاء الملك الخيّر، سيطرت الملكة الشريرة على البلاد التي كانت جميلةً يومًا ما بوحشية. هربت الأميرة سنو وايت من القلعة عندما حاولت الملكة، بدافع غيرتها من جمال سنو وايت الداخلي، قتلها. في أعماق الغابة المظلمة، صادفت سبعة أقزام سحريين وشابًا يُدعى جوناثان. يكافحون معًا للنجاة من مطاردة الملكة المتواصلة، ويطمحون لاستعادة المملكة.

name: The Stolen Valley 2025
plot: To save her dying mother, a Mexican-Navajo mechanic bands together with an outlaw cowgirl to confront a corrupt landowner.

name: Night Of Deception 2025
plot: Two friends work as cleaners whose jobs are to clean homes and places where people have died or dead bodies are found. One day, they are tasked with cleaning a house where there were three dead bodies inside. Their job is to clean the corpses that have rotted. When they arrived there, they found that there are strange things happening and then they discover a strange book.

name: The Devil′s Hacksaw 2025
plot: في بلدة صغيرة هادئة في بنسلفانيا، ينشب رعبٌ عندما يهرب أحد نزلاء مصحّ غرايستون الشهير. متعطشًا للانتقام، يشرع في ارتكاب مجزرة وحشية، تاركًا أهل البلدة في حالة من الذعر.

name: American Wages 2025
plot: في أحد الأيام، لاحظ الزوجان جاك وآشلي، اللذان يعانيان من صعوبات مالية، شاحنة متوقفة في مدخل منزلهما وعلى متنها رجل يحتضر وحقيبتان رياضيتان مملوءتان بمبلغ نقدي غيّر حياتهما، مما دفعهما إلى مواجهة معضلات أخلاقية وعواقب وخيمة في محاولتهما تغيير حياتهما. قرارهما بالاحتفاظ بالمال يتداخل مع مصيرهما بشكوك الشريف دوليون وقوى الجريمة المحلية الخطيرة، مما يفاقم التوترات ويهدد أحلامهما بمستقبل أفضل.

name: All India Rank 2025
plot: فيفيك يبلغ من العمر سبعة عشر عامًا، وكما تشهد كل عائلة من الطبقة المتوسطة في الهند، فقد حان الوقت للتسجيل في دورات تدريبية لامتحانات القبول في المعاهد الهندية للتكنولوجيا (IITs) المعروفة بتنافسيتها الشديدة. والد فيفيك، الذي يعتبر شهادة المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا شهادة أخلاقية، يرسل ابنه الوحيد إلى مدرسة داخلية تحضيرية في كوتا، قبلة التدريب على المعاهد الهندية للتكنولوجيا. على مدار عامين، يمر فيفيك بفترة المراهقة الهندية، لكن والديه هما من يتولى مسؤولية نموه.

name: Broke 2025
plot: A bronc rider in denial about his fading rodeo career battles against brain injury and a sudden blizzard while reflecting on how it became so difficult to achieve his dreams.

name: Karol G: Tomorrow Was Beautiful 2025
plot: Karol G pulls back the curtain on her rise to stardom while navigating a sold-out stadium tour, creating new music and releasing a new album.

name: Kryptic 2025
plot: A woman’s search for a missing cryptzoologist leads to her own riveting cosmic quest for identity.

name: La Cocina 2025
plot: In the sweltering back kitchen of a Times Square restaurant, undocumented cook Pedro is caught between mounting pressures at work and a complicated romance with waitress Julia. When money goes missing, suspicion spreads, igniting tensions that threaten to upend the fragile hopes of the staff.

name: The Luckiest Man in America 2025
plot: 1984; Michael Larson, an unemployed ice-cream truck driver from Ohio, steps onto the game show "Press Your Luck" harboring a secret: the key to endless amounts of money. But his winning streak is threatened when the executives in the control room start to uncover his real motivations.

name: The Most Precious Of Cargoes 2025
plot: Once upon a time, a poor woodcutter and his wife lived in a great forest. Cold, hunger, poverty, and a war raging all around them meant their lives were very hard.  One day, the woodcutter's wife rescues a baby. A baby girl thrown from one of the many trains that constantly pass through the forest. This baby, this "most precious of cargoes", will transform the lives of the poor woodcutter's wife and her husband, as well as those whose paths the child will cross—including the man who threw her from the train. And some will try to protect her, whatever the cost. Their story will reveal the worst and the best in the hearts of men.

name: The Ugly Stepsister 2025
plot: In a fairy-tale kingdom where beauty is a brutal business, Elvira battles to compete with her incredibly beautiful stepsister, and she will go to any length to catch the prince’s eye.

name: Untold Shooting Guards 2025
plot: What really went down between Gilbert Arenas and Javaris Crittenton? This exposé unpacks how a gambling dispute led to guns drawn in an NBA locker room.
